purpose: Ensure positive biotic dependence is represented as an eligible truth mechanism, not only as a restrictive false-world contrast.

additional_preregistered_tests.claim: When obligate-partner truth is nested inside an otherwise identical no-B world, positive occurrences alone cannot establish the partner dependence.

Under the perfect-detection equilibrium contract, diagnostic negatives outside the partner-limited truth can eliminate the corresponding no-B superset world whenever that world predicts extra occupied nodes.

interpretation_boundary: H7 is a statement about insufficiency of positive-only evidence, not absence of a true interaction.
H8 depends on perfect detection/equilibrium and is not automatically transferable to presence-only empirical data.
One-way interaction dependence is modeled; reciprocal eco-evolutionary feedback is outside v2.2.
